question: 瘦西湖水质监测的具体指标有哪些？最近一个月哪些指标变化最显著？
expected_sql:
SELECT '溶解氧' AS '指标', MAX(dox) - MIN(dox) AS '变化幅度'
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%' AND b.sttp = 'WQ'
  AND d.spt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND d.dox IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CODMn', MAX(codmn) - MIN(codmn)
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%' AND b.sttp = 'WQ'
  AND d.spt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND d.codmn IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT '氨氮', MAX(nh3n) - MIN(nh3n)
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%' AND b.sttp = 'WQ'
  AND d.spt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND d.nh3n IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT '总磷', MAX(tp) - MIN(tp)
FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
WHERE b.stnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%' AND b.sttp = 'WQ'
  AND d.spt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND d.tp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY '变化幅度' DESC;

SELECT stcd, stnm, rvnm, sttp 
    FROM sl323.st_stbprp_b 
    WHERE sttp='WQ' AND (stnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%' OR rvnm LIKE '%瘦西湖%')

SELECT DATE(d.spt) AS '日期',
           ROUND(AVG(d.dox),2)   AS '溶解氧(mg/L)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.codmn),2) AS 'CODMn(mg/L)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.nh3n),3)  AS '氨氮(mg/L)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.tp),3)    AS '总磷(mg/L)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.ph),2)    AS 'pH',
           ROUND(AVG(d.wtmp),1)  AS '水温(℃)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.turb),1)  AS '浊度(NTU)',
           ROUND(AVG(d.cond),1)  AS '电导率(μS/cm)',
           COUNT(*) AS '采样次数'
    FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
    JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
    WHERE b.sttp='WQ' AND (b.stnm LIKE '%{STN}%' OR b.rvnm LIKE '%{STN}%')
      AND d.spt > DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(spt) FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    GROUP BY DATE(d.spt) ORDER BY DATE(d.spt)

SELECT

           ROUND(MAX(d.nh3n) - MIN(d.nh3n), 3) AS '氨氮变化幅度',

    FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d d
    JOIN sl323.st_stbprp_b b ON d.stcd = b.stcd
    WHERE b.sttp='WQ' AND (b.stnm LIKE '%{STN}%' OR b.rvnm LIKE '%{STN}%')
      AND d.spt > DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(spt) FROM sl325.wq_pcp_d), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT
